prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that does RFC 7231-style parsing: splits on ',' and ';', strips whitespace, and excludes entries with q=0, with wildcard type/subtype matching. #2046's fix uses a plain `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` substring check, which can false-positive on adjacent media types (e.g. 'application/json-patch+json', 'application/jsonp') and ignores q=0 'not acceptable' signals that the client explicitly set. Both edit the exact same lines, so they conflict with each other; #1996's implementation handles more of the Accept-header edge cases correctly.
